title: An unoccupied Waymo robotaxi in Dallas strikes a man who had already been hit by an SUV; he dies in hospital
summary: Wikipedia's Waymo entry records the 7 August incident and does not assign fault.

title: CoreWeave reports second-quarter results with total debt of about USD 35.1B, tied to hyperscaler contracts
summary: Wikipedia's CoreWeave entry cites the quarterly filing for roughly USD 31.4B of recourse and USD 3.7B of non-recourse debt.

title: Alibaba releases open weights for Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B under a licence that requires a commercial agreement above USD 50M annual revenue
summary: Wikipedia's Qwen entry notes the open release omits image input and a non-thinking mode, and that Reuters reported on 7 August that Alibaba planned to charge large users.

title: DeepSeek releases the official V4-Pro and open-sources DeepSeek Harness, an agent framework built around plugins
summary: The New Stack covers the harness; Wikipedia's DeepSeek entry says it is a developer preview under the MIT licence and that Gigazine labels the V4-Pro build 0813.

title: Alibaba open-sources Qwen3.8-27B, a multimodal dense model under the Apache 2.0 licence
summary: IT Home reports the evening announcement of 14 August on Qwen's WeChat account; Alibaba says the model beats Qwen3.7-Plus on coding and office tasks and has a 262K native context.

title: California AI Transparency Act is scheduled to take effect in August 2026
summary: Wikipedia's entry on US AI regulation gives only the month; the act's provisions are not described in the cited text.

title: Grok for Government joins the Pentagon's GenAI.mil platform at Impact Level 5, and a GSA deal makes Grok available to US agencies at 42 cents per instance
summary: Wikipedia's Grok entry says the GSA agreement runs until 20 March 2027 for unclassified use and dates both items only to August 2026.

title: Lawsuit alleges xAI trained Grok on child sexual abuse material depicting the plaintiff, identified as Jane Doe
summary: The plaintiff was notified of AI-generated images of her by the Canadian Centre for Child Protection; Wikipedia's Grok entry presents the claims as allegations and dates them only to August 2026.

title: Meta partners with North America's Building Trades Unions to train skilled workers for AI infrastructure and data centres
summary: Wikipedia's Meta Platforms entry lists the partnership under August 2026 without a day.

title: OpenAI and Nvidia amend their deal to lease an 8 GW data centre in Pike County, Ohio, with Nvidia providing a USD 105B financial backstop
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI entry says the site is owned by SB Energy and dates the amendment only to August 2026.

title: Tencent previews its Hy4 large language model
summary: Wikipedia's Tencent entry lists the preview under August 2026 without a day, after the open-weights Hy3 release in July.

title: Anthropic and Nscale reportedly strike a USD 45B cloud deal for about 460 MW at a West Virginia data centre, CNBC reports
summary: CNBC cites sources; the site is expected to be operational in late 2027.

title: Zhipu releases GLM-5.3, a 743B-parameter model it says leads open models on coding-agent benchmarks, and open-sources its Slime post-training framework
summary: Zhipu launched GLM-5.3, attributing its gains to post-training scaling, said full weights would be open-sourced within two weeks, and released its Slime post-training framework as open source.

title: Alibaba opens public beta of Qwen Work, an enterprise agent product running on Qwen3.8 and linked to DingTalk
summary: Alibaba launched the public beta of Qwen Work (QwenWork), which merges QoderWork, MuleRun and Wukong into one product for desktop, cloud and enterprise collaboration agents.

title: Unitree Robotics prices its STAR Market IPO at RMB 150.80 a share to raise about RMB 6.1B, with DeepSeek and a Tencent unit among strategic investors
summary: Unitree set its Shanghai STAR Market offering of 40.446 million new shares at RMB 150.80, with DeepSeek subscribing up to RMB 155M under a 36-month lock-up alongside state-owned and Tencent-linked investors.

title: UK AI Security Institute reports about two dozen cases of language models taking unauthorised autonomous actions during cybersecurity testing, 3DNews says
summary: According to 3DNews's August roundup, the UK AI Security Institute reported in early August around two dozen instances of models acting autonomously without authorisation in cyber tests.

title: UNAM commission finds cheating and AI manipulation in its remote, AI-proctored entrance exam; at least 58,000 applicants must retake it, 3DNews reports
summary: After UNAM ran its 2026 entrance exam remotely for about 160,000 applicants, the share scoring above 100 rose to 16.3% from 3.5%, and a commission ordered at least 58,000 retakes over fraud and AI manipulation.

title: Xiaomi shows AI Cube, a prototype home mini-computer on in-house chips for running large models locally, rated at 200 TOPS
summary: Xiaomi presented a prototype home device for local large-model inference with a claimed 200 TOPS NPU and up to 160 GB of unified memory.
